evidence.title: FDA: Mifepristone review won’t be done until March

occurrences.checkable_against: Reproductive Freedom for All statement by Mini Timmaraju
occurrences.quote_span: “Mifepristone is a safe and effective medication backed by decades of science – this ‘review’ is an unnecessary political stunt,” Reproductive Freedom for All President and CEO Mini Timmaraju said in a statement.
occurrences.speaker: Mini Timmaraju
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA court filing on final mifepristone study results
occurrences.quote_span: FDA anticipates that it will be able to provide an update to its estimated date of completion as more information becomes known, particularly in March 2027 when it expects to complete its report on the final study results.”
occurrences.speaker: FDA
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Marjorie Dannenfelser's statement and the Ethics and Public Policy Center analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Marjorie Dannenfelser, president of Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America, said in a statement ahead of Wednesday’s update that she wants FDA to include a non-peer-reviewed analysis released last year by the conservative Ethics and Public Policy Center, which critics have called “flawed” and “junk science.”
occurrences.speaker: Marjorie Dannenfelser
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statements from anti-abortion groups about the FDA mifepristone review
occurrences.quote_span: Anti-abortion groups hope the review will result in restrictions on mifepristone, but they want the FDA to move faster.
occurrences.speaker: Anti-abortion groups
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Missouri federal court docket and briefing schedule in the mifepristone case
occurrences.quote_span: while the Missouri case is still being briefed.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Trump administration court filings in the Louisiana mifepristone lawsuit
occurrences.quote_span: The case has put the Trump administration in an awkward political bind; it won’t defend the Biden administration’s moves, but it also believes Louisiana doesn’t have standing to sue.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA Sentinel data review records
occurrences.quote_span: FDA said it is reviewing data contained within Sentinel, a national database partnered with insurers, hospitals, electronic health records and academic institutions, among other groups.
occurrences.speaker: FDA
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal court dockets for FDA mifepristone lawsuits
occurrences.quote_span: FDA’s disclosure Wednesday stems from a lawsuit in Louisiana, one of three the agency is facing regarding mifepristone.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA Wednesday court filing on mifepristone safety review
occurrences.quote_span: it won’t impose any new restrictions on the pill before that point.
occurrences.speaker: FDA
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA court filing describing its mifepristone REMS review
occurrences.quote_span: The agency confirmed it is separately reviewing the safety program that regulates the distribution and use of mifepristone, called a “Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy” — a protocol the FDA uses for drugs with “serious safety concerns.”
occurrences.speaker: FDA
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Louisiana federal court complaint and Biden-era FDA mifepristone regulations
occurrences.quote_span: The Louisiana lawsuit challenges Biden-era FDA rules that allow the drug to be prescribed virtually and mailed to patients.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal court dockets for Missouri and Texas mifepristone cases
occurrences.quote_span: The other legal challenges came out of Missouri and Texas.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA five-page update filed in Louisiana federal court
occurrences.quote_span: In a five-page update filed in a Louisiana federal court, the agency said it is on track to obtain study results by mid-December but won’t finish its report until March.
occurrences.speaker: FDA
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA Wednesday court filing on mifepristone safety review
occurrences.quote_span: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) won’t publish its safety review of the abortion drug mifepristone until March, it disclosed in a Wednesday court filing, adding that it won’t impose any new restrictions on the pill before that point.
occurrences.speaker: FDA
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: National abortion statistics and telehealth prescription data
occurrences.quote_span: Medication has become the most common method of abortion since the 2022 overturning of Roe v. Wade, with much of that increase coming from telehealth prescriptions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: Reproductive Freedom for All statement by Mini Timmaraju
occurrences.quote_span: “The administration is delaying this report because attacks on medication abortion will backfire with voters, but extremists will try to ban abortion as soon as the election is over.”
occurrences.speaker: Mini Timmaraju
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA court filing and citizen petitions concerning mifepristone prescribing rules
occurrences.quote_span: That process could take much longer, as the FDA said it will need to review the hundreds of citations included in various citizen petitions urging changes to the prescribing rules, such as the in-person dispensing requirement.
occurrences.speaker: FDA
occurrences.subject: FDA mifepristone safety review
